name: sharded-progress-source
cmd: set -euo pipefail; ROOT=$PWD; OUT=$SUPERCOMPUTER_OUTPUT_DIR; bun install --frozen-lockfile > "$OUT/install.log" 2>&1; bun scripts/gen-lean-library.ts > "$OUT/library-gen.log" 2>&1; cp lean-kernel/library.ts "$OUT/library.ts"; printf '%s\n' 'docs(bapa): record sharded progress proof and source check' > "$OUT/commit-message.txt"; bunx @commitlint/cli --config research/egraph/historical/commitlint.config.cjs < "$OUT/commit-message.txt" > "$OUT/commitlint.log" 2>&1; bun research/bapa/proof-emit.ts --capture sharded-progress-capsule --sha256 a1885c7c4098ee59f7bfb7d67fff7b379be293f7baa8343b1c8c61c34c4185b2 --projection alpha --out "$OUT/project" > "$OUT/emission.log" 2>&1; cd "$OUT/project"; lake build > "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; lake env lean BapaProof.lean >> "$OUT/lean.log" 2>&1; bun "$ROOT/scripts/lean-gate/gate.ts" "$OUT/lean.log" BapaProof.lean > "$OUT/axioms.log" 2>&1; sha256sum "$OUT/lean.log" EMITTED.json BapaProof.lean > "$OUT/checked-hashes.txt"; rm -rf .lake
